text:
harper_ops: Heads-up: inland transfer report from FRA -> NL hub shows coolant line leak during loading. We have residue on pallet wraps. Initial scan: 7 DOA, 5 flaky units with thermal_trip during boot. Quarantining the rest at NL-CD05.

sam_procure: PO# 60521? how many total affected? do we have manifests/photos?

harper_ops: PO 60521, batch size 240, affected sample set = 12 flagged from 120 tested. Photos uploaded to NX-claims. Forwarder submitted SDR.

jo_logistics: pulling the container notes. Broker warns: if we move units as imports we'll get duty assessed on full value unless we reclass as repair parts. Need HS amendment.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor says probable micro-contamination from a ruptured coolant hose in the truck. Options: depot connector reseal + bench reflow kits, or vendor air ship replacements for critical slots. Their commercial: 2.5% credit + kits, or 100% air at our cost unless we accept 1% additional credit.

maria_sales: customers will panic if EU allocations drop. Recommend we route EU traffic to global buffer for 4 days and secure at least 16 air replacements for top S1 customers.

claims-bot: Claim IC-2026-982 created. Adjuster assigned: K. Novak. Required: photos, containment report, truck manifest, humidity/hydraulic sensor logs.

harper_ops: ops ask: insist on per-serial preflight bench logs for any reworked unit and require vendor to include `bench_id`, `therm_profile`, and a KV cache retention graph. We cannot accept reworked units without those.

sam_procure: commercial ask to vendor: cover return freight, provide depot preflight logs, and 3.5% credit on PO if we accept depot repair. Also demand vendor supplies tech kits at no charge for EU depots.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor counter: 3% credit + free tech kits, but only covers return freight for units that fail initial depot triage. Air replacements: they will expedite up to 20 units in 5 days if we sign a limited salvage waiver for units they mark as non-repairable.

jo_logistics: legal risk: salvage waiver could impede insurance recovery. We should not sign salvage language before insurer confirms. Broker: HS amendment AM-60521 filed (repair classification) ETA 18-30h.

harper_ops: quick depot test for flaky units (depot-tech please run):
```
# depot quick burn + KV check
stress-test --duration 30m --load 0.9 --log /tmp/$SERIAL.therm
inference-bench --model tinybert --seq 16 --iters 40 --kv-check --out /tmp/$SERIAL.bench
grep "thermal_trip\|kv_retention_fail" /tmp/$SERIAL.* | tail -n 20
```

depot-tech: starting runs on 10 suspect units. will tag `coolant-contact` or `rma-suspect` and upload logs.

sam_procure: negotiation boundary: if vendor signs to provide per-serial bench logs for all repaired/replaced units, covers return freight and supplies depot kits, accept 3% credit + 16 air units within 5 days for critical accounts. Otherwise escalate.

nexa_supply_ops: pushing vendor for that. Vendor now offers: 3% credit + return freight covered + 12 air units in 5 days, depot kits free. They refuse full bench logs for salvage-marked units but will provide preflight logs for depot-repaired units.

maria_sales: 12 air units might be just enough if we prioritize correctly. I'll map top 12 customers and request SLA exceptions.

harper_ops: technical stipulation: any preflight logs must include KV cache retention test and a 45m thermal burn. If vendor won't do 45m, we insist on vendor-run 30m + our depot-run 45m before redeploy. Add that to RMA metadata.

jo_logistics: note on customs: if HS amendment delays, we may face detention fees. Need quick clearance or route to temporary bonded yard. Filing for bonded transfer now.

claims-bot: Adjuster Novak requested truck telemetry: coolant pressure drops logged at 2026-03-16 02:11 UTC. Photos show wet pallet wrap. Insurance hold advised until claim docs complete.

sam_procure: final commercial call in 35m. Goal: lock 16 air units, vendor covers return freight & depot kits, and vendor signs preflight log commitment for depot repairs. If vendor holds to 12 air only and refuses full preflight logs, escalate to procurement head.

maria_sales: I'll draft the neutral customer message: "A small subset of recent H200 units are quarantined due to transit contamination. We're prioritizing replacements for highest-impact customers and performing additional QA. We'll provide daily updates." Keep tone calm.

harper_ops: ops checklist before call: 1) finish 10 depot burns, 2) tag failing serials, 3) prepare RMA draft with metadata fields [unit_count, preflight_required, bench_fields], 4) ensure bonded yard option ready. I'll run 1-2.

depot-tech: first 10 runs: 3 DOA, 2 thermal_trip on 25-35m, 5 pass with minor residue and cleanable. Uploading logs and photos now.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor said they'll send updated commercial terms and a preflight spec in app in ~2h. If they meet the bench requirement and air units count, we accept and proceed with crossdock transfers.

sam_procure: tagging legal for salvage waiver contingency. Do not sign any waiver until insurer confirms.

jo_logistics: bonded transfer request submitted. HS amend in progress. Will post clearance update.

maria_sales: thanks team. keep customer comms ready. I'll wait for vendor amendment then finalize message. :white_check_mark:
